requirements.proposal_wording: Reconstruct chronological attack timeline from ingested normalized security events.
Separate attack activity into distinct attack simulation episodes.
Represent attack progression as sequences of MITRE ATT&CK techniques and tactics.
Predict the most likely next attack technique using a first-order Markov model.
Output transition probabilities and ranked candidates for next-step predictions.
Provide alternative candidate predictions beyond the top prediction.
Provide structured explanations and supporting empirical evidence for predictions.
Integrate contextual intelligence and incident priority signals from Component 3 (C3).
Display incident progression, prediction results, and explanation summaries for forensic analysts.

requirements.proposal_title: Performance ("acceptable response time", the proposal gives no number)
requirements.proposal_wording: Achieve acceptable response time for digital forensic investigation.
Produce consistent and reliable predictions across repeated evaluations.

requirements.proposal_title: Security (shall not modify original event records from C3)
requirements.proposal_wording: Shall not modify original event records from C3 during ingestion and processing.
Provide an intuitive and interpretable interface for forensic triage.
Accept and process structured event records conforming to C3 interface specifications.
Ensure model outputs and reasoning are transparent and verifiable by forensic experts.
